note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for SC-401, 'Skills measured as of July 28, 2026'. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Implement information protection
subtopics: Identify sensitive information requirements and translate them into built-in or custom sensitive info types
Create and manage custom sensitive info types and implement document fingerprinting
Create and manage exact data match (EDM) based sensitive information types
Create and manage trainable classifiers
Monitor classification and label usage with Data explorer and Content explorer
Configure optical character recognition support for sensitive info types
Define and create sensitivity labels for items and containers, with protection and content marking
Configure publishing and auto-labeling policies for sensitivity labels
Plan and implement the Purview Information Protection client and scanner
Design and implement Purview Message Encryption and Advanced Message Encryption

domains.name: Implement data loss prevention and retention
subtopics: Design data loss prevention policies based on organisational requirements
Implement roles and permissions for data loss prevention
Create and manage data loss prevention policies and configure them for Adaptive Protection
Interpret policy and rule precedence in data loss prevention
Create file policies in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps using a DLP policy
Specify device requirements for Endpoint DLP and configure advanced rules for devices
Configure Endpoint DLP settings and just-in-time protection, and monitor endpoint activities
Plan retention and disposition with retention labels and adaptive policy scopes
Configure retention label policies to publish and to auto-apply labels
Interpret policy precedence using Policy lookup, and recover retained content

domains.name: Manage risks, alerts, and activities
subtopics: Implement roles, permissions, and connectors for Insider Risk Management
Configure Insider Risk Management settings, policy indicators, and policy templates
Manage forensic evidence settings and insider risk levels for Adaptive Protection
Manage insider risk alerts, cases, and the notice template workflow
Assign Purview Audit (Premium) licences and investigate activities with Purview Audit
Configure audit retention policies and analyse activities with Activity explorer
Respond to data loss prevention alerts and to Purview alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
Perform searches by using eDiscovery
Implement Purview and workload controls to protect content used by AI services
Implement prerequisites, roles, policies, and monitoring for DSPM for AI
